build_vgg_model: build a VGG model with configurable num_classes for image classification using pycls config
run_vgg_forward: run the VGG forward pass on an input tensor through conv bn blocks and pooling layers
create_conv_bn_block: create a conv bn block with optional stem flag using convbasic or convtalk transform
review_vgg_architecture: review the VGG model architecture with four max pooling stages and adaptive average pooling
test_vgg_init_weights: test the VGG model initialization by applying nu.init_weights to all modules
